title: Eagles GM Howie Roseman: All four QBs have value to us, won't name No. 2 at this point

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eagles GM Howie Roseman: All four QBs have value to us, won't name No. 2 at this point
sources.description: The Eagles' backup quarterback job was the subject of plenty of speculation over the course of the summer, but the team ended up passing on a decision to get rid of either Tanner McKee or Andy Dalton.
